title: A standard-smooth map admits an etale polynomial chart
statement: Let $R$ and $A$ be commutative rings and let $R\to A$ be standard smooth of relative dimension $d$ [def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra]. There is an etale $R$-algebra map $\psi:R[X_0,\ldots,X_{d-1}]\to A$ (its map of affine spectra is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]) whose composite with the constant-polynomial map $R\to R[X_0,\ldots,X_{d-1}]$ is the given map $R\to A$.
